hostingDisclosureEn: This site uses GitHub Pages (GitHub). When you visit a published page, GitHub may process technical request data such as IP address, browser/device information, requested pages, date/time and logs needed for service delivery and security. Processing may take place in the United States and other countries where GitHub and its providers operate. Retention depends on GitHub's purposes and legal obligations; Z-Aura's owner has not set or promised a fixed GitHub Pages log deletion period. See https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement. Choosing hosting does not mean these updated pages are already deployed.
